verdict.rationale: Windmill documents optional Error and Recovery Handlers on schedules to deal with failed scheduled executions. Its error-handling docs also let a run be retagged as a failure via `wm_failure`, and steps can be retried on error. That is a real, product-native error-workflow capability, but the evidence only covers scheduled runs, and failure notification is not documented as such. Missing for 10: flow-level error-handler paths for non-scheduled runs, explicit failure notification channels, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define dedicated error-handling paths or error workflows and get notified when a run fails

citations.quote: optional Error and Recovery Handlers to deal with failed scheduled executions
A script or flow can return a top-level `wm_failure` field (string) to retag the run as a failure even though the runtime did not raise an error.
If defined, upon error this step will be retried with a delay and a maximum number of attempts as defined below.
